consigne_scene: Top-down photograph of a photographer's light table in a dim room: a large glowing panel of warm white light filling most of the frame, completely empty in the middle, a worn black metal frame around it, at one corner a red grease pencil and a small square magnifying loupe lying on dark wood, faint dust on the glass, soft vignetting towards the edges, nothing else

An empty theatre stage seen from the wings at a low angle, a single warm follow spot drawing a soft circle of light on worn black floorboards, a heavy dark velvet curtain edge in the foreground, the dark auditorium barely visible beyond, light haze in the beam, nobody on stage

consigne_scene: A small private screening room in the dark, seen from the back rows: a few rows of empty dark velvet seats, a beam of projector light crossing the room through floating dust towards a blank, evenly lit pale screen at the front, warm shadows, nobody in the room

A quiet voice recording booth at night: a vintage silver ribbon microphone on a stand with a round pop filter in the left third, dark grey acoustic foam on the walls, a music stand with a few blank sheets of paper, a single warm lamp, deep shadows, nobody in the booth

A rehearsal room table seen from above at an angle: a loose stack of script pages with only illegible blurred lines, a red pencil, a pair of reading glasses and a cup of coffee on dark worn wood, warm lamp light from the side, strong shallow depth of field, nothing readable

A film set between takes in a dim interior: a folded wooden director's chair, a blank black clapperboard with no writing resting on it, a soft light stand with a diffusion frame glowing in the background, cables on the floor, warm and cool light mixing, shallow depth of field, nobody in the frame

A narrow backstage corridor of a small theatre, a dressing-room door ajar letting out warm light, a rack of dark costumes on hangers, a blank cork board, old painted brick walls, deep shadows, nobody in the corridor
An empty black theatre stage with a single wooden chair standing alone in a narrow pool of warm light, the rest of the stage in deep shadow, faint haze, nobody
